class.name: RailVehicleElectroPneumaticDynamicBrake
class.brief_description: Class used to handle Electro Pneumatic and Electro Dynamic brakes along with their parameters.
class.description: Class used to handle Electro Pneumatic and Electro Dynamic brakes along with their parameters. Useful in Electric/Hybrid/Diesel Multiple Units and newer locomotives as elder locos don't have such braking systems

method.name: get_ed_braking_ep_delay
method.description: How long the EP brake waits before it joins electrodynamic braking [s] ([code]DCEMUED_EP_delay[/code]).

method.name: get_ep_fuse
method.description: Whether the EP brake's fuse is on ([code]EpFuse[/code]).

method.name: get_ep_max_brake_engagement_speed
method.description: The speed above which the EP brake stays off while the electrodynamic brake works [km/h] ([code]DCEMUED_EP_max_Vel[/code], [code]Mover.cpp:4215[/code]).

method.name: get_ep_min_regenerative_braking
method.description: The motor current above which the EP brake stays off while the electrodynamic brake works [lb]A[rb] ([code]DCEMUED_EP_min_Im[/code], [code]Mover.cpp:4217[/code]).

method.name: switch_ep_fuse
method.description: Switch Electro Pneumatic brake on or off

members.member: State of Electro Pneumatic brake fuse

constants.constant: The electrodynamic brake of no neighbour is checked ([code]DCEMUED_CC[/code]).
The electrodynamic brake of the neighbour at the front coupler is checked, over the control line ([code]Mover.cpp:1544[/code]).
